title: Participation weights multiplied by censoring weights under heavy censoring and poor overlap
question: Does the TADA estimator, participation weights times inverse-probability-of-censoring weights with bootstrap variance, stay unbiased and well calibrated when censoring is heavy, overlap poor and the two weight sets correlated?
design: Transported RMST difference from a two-arm trial with covariate-dependent censoring; 25% or 60% censoring, good or poor overlap, positively or negatively correlated weight sets, plus two null controls; participation-only Kaplan-Meier, TADA with bootstrap and fixed-weight sandwich SE, TADA with a misspecified censoring model. 10 cells, 500 replicates each.
